balls.text: Swing and a miss, Pant throws down the striker's stumps. Harshal well short. Was a short slow ball outside off, Aniket went for the pull and took off right after being beaten
Bouncer beats the pull, Pant doesn't collect clearly and they SRH review for a wide. Side-on replay shows ball just under the helmet. No measurements needed
Bowlers getting the boundaries for SRH. His knew it'd be a yorker attempt. Ended up being a full ball on off, he swung straight, opened the face a touch to lift the ball over extra cover
Yorkers are so back in style! 137.4ks, slanting in and hitting offf stump. Shivang got low and looked to hit straight, ball was too low and too quick
Why farm strike when Shivang can do the job? He crawls outside off, stays in the crease and laps a very low full toss on off, over short fine leg
Nutmegged, Pant saves three... Dives to the left. Aniket takes the run. Was a yorker on leg, cleared the front leg and went for the flick. It clipped the back leg
Will farm strike, Aniket did go for the boundary. It was a full toss after all. Swiped across, got it along the ground to deep midwicket
Goes outside off, yorker follows him and it's punched to cover.
Full on leg, flicked to long-on
Length on off, Shivang wanted to tap and run. Defended into the pitch, back onto his face

Chopped on and the stadium in quiet. Avesh goes back of length outside off, cross seamer, Dubey dances down and looks to cut it. Not enough room, swung too high too. Under-edge goes back onto hot stump.

Premeditation ends up with a diving catch for Pant. Klaasen shaped to play the reverse lap before the delivery. Avesh went full around off, then it became a matter of execution. But Klaasen lobbed it to Pant's right

This is a good ball. Klaasen was premeditating the sweep while standing still, so Siddharth goes wide with the low full toss. Hands reaching out means ball has to be hit into the ground, goes to deep midwicket. Good over from Siddharth
Yorker on off, driven straight to long-off. Siddharth trusting his lengths
The wide line works. Reddy went for the right shot, lifting it off the front foot like he has against pace and spin. Can't get the height on it, deep cover takes it
Goes for the wide yorker again, the full toss goes outside the tramline
This full toss.... almost does the trick. Shin-high and well wide, slapped on the bounce to deep cover, running in
And the full toss doesn't travel... A bit wide, slapped wide of long-off
Can't miss lengths, doesn't miss by much. Near yorker lands just in front of the crease, Klaasen clears his front leg and drives straight over the bowler
No changes or improvisation needed to whack away a yorker. Gets forward, then low and lifts a cover drive. Getting under that ball was the main thing
Yorker is chomped back to the bowler. Just outside off, Reddy looking to smother it with a full follow-through. Can't. Good bowling
Short just outside off, cut to deep cover
Very low full toss on off, springs down a touch and drives to deep point
Follows through with the off drive with panache, hits long-off and gets fifty. Razor-sharp celebration, scissoring the bat under the chin
Yorker on leg, flicked to deep square leg. 132ks
Good change up. Slow bouncer just outside off, pulled to deep square leg. Flags fly and cheers return as Klaasen brings up fifty. Timeout
Another yorker. On middle and off again, Klaasen jams it back to the bowler again
Nails the yorker. That option will be taken a lot from now on. At the stumps, jammed to long-on
Hit hard but not timed, finds cover. Reddy trying to lift a length ball but gets it highish off the bat and into the ground
Short just outside off, pulled into the ground. Goes to long-on
No second invitation needed. Klaasen gets the slot ball on middle, stays leg side of the ball and muscles a drive over the bowler. 80 metres
Reddy's picking them and punishing them! Front of the hand this time. On a length outside off, no turn. Reddy doesn't move, swings across and clears long-on with ease
Wide and shortish, cut to deep point

Goes for the reverse sweep and misses. Given wide, LSG review. Back of length lands outside off and turns away sharply. No part of the ball is inside the imaginary line over the tramline. LSG burn the review
Back of length, pulled to deep midwicket
Flat six over long-off! Too full again, in Reddy's reach. Doesn't have to do much before swiping across. 100 up for SRH, that didn't seem possible a while back
Slot ball has been thumped! Legbreak on middle allows Reddy the step hit. Bends his back knee and lifts it over long-on. Sumptuous lofted drive
Gets away with a wide one. Front-of-the-hand length ball is cut to deep cover point
Length around off, 130ks, driven on top of the bounce to long-off

Pulls and gets another boundary! Avesh's bouncers not working. This one was pace-on but didn't zip off the pitch, Klaasen had to wait a while before pulling from the front of the body through midwicket
Smeared into the ground and beats cover again, no one chasing this time. Pitched up wide, Klaasen stands his ground, bends his knees and gets his hands low before blazing it through
Short outside off, dragged to deep midwicket with a pull
Beats cover and the infielder is beaten in a long chase. Remarkable timing. Back of length, top of off, Klaasen stood just outside the stumps and was able to punch it with a vertical bat
Freebie. Short, wide and sits up. Klaasen lifts the back leg and slaps it from shoulder-height over cover
WIde and full, cross-bat caress takes it to deep cover
WIde yorker darted, right on the line. Let go
Length ball is worked to long-on
Looks like a drop. Yes it is. Mukul ran and was diving low to the right. Ball didn't go in the hands properly. Was a length ball that was clobbered across the line
Wide, low full toss, slapped to deep cover

Reddy is getting into overs with boundaries. Dances down and goes inside out over extra cover this time. Skimmer. Got to the pitch nicely and the ball was a couple of stumps away from him, well in reach
Vertical-bat pull almost, Klaasen winding up big and bringing the bat down with force. Hits the pitch and rolls to long-on's left
Length outside off, punched off the back foot through cover
Tight two, they make it. Ball never crossed the ring. Nitish flicked the fullish ball and took off right away. No one in the ring there, long-on had to run in
Cut very late, effectively too. Beats backward point. Nitish ready for the change in line, knows Rathi won't bowl too full, so he slashes when the ball almost passed his bat
Cuffed down the ground, beats long-on to the left. Back of length stock ball, may have turned away a touch, Reddy clears the front foot and swivels to pull it into the ground
A bit of room and a touch short, cut to deep point. Klaasen doesn't need room to cut
Seemed slow. Yeah, it is. Dug in very short, spins in towards off stump. Klaasen accounts for it and times the pull nicely, to deep midwicket
Full toss has been smacked with disdain. Thigh-high, angling in on off stump, Klaasen waits for it and swings across the line to clear the midwicket fence. 78 metres six
Short just outside off, Reddy stays still and pulls early. Finds long-on
Low full toss on off, flicked to deep-backward square
Back of length, angling in, flicked off the back foot to midwicket
Second six of the innings, SRH have starved for it. They get it with a wide fullish ball that Reddy slashes off the front foot over long-off. Mostly a diagonal bat
Wow. He stands outside leg after giving himself room, and Siddharth goes on a length wide of off. Left alone by Klaasen
this time drives to long-off. He plays hard at this full ball on middle and off
much fuller, and quicker. On leg, and he drives to short midwicket

loud appeal for lbw, but turned down. I thought that was heading down the leg side. Siddharth asks Pant what he thinks, and the LSG captain doesn't review. Nitish went for the reverse sweep at this length ball angled into leg, and pitching there. But the angle would have taken it down further
fuller and quicker, and on off. Punched to short cover
bottom edge, and past Pant. Klaasen goes slashing at this length ball slightly wide of off, but doesn't get the timing and placement right. The ball goes between Pant's legs for three
nope, but he finishes off a very impactful spell. It's 2 for 9 after four overs. This is a fullish delivery just outside off, and Nitish drives to the man at short cover
back to the short ball. This is slightly wide of off, and Klaasen swat-pulls to long-on
lack of pace from Shami this time. He bowls on a length, and around sixth stump. Slapped to deep cover point
shorter side of a length on off, and nudged to the man close in at midwicket
follows a short ball with a yorker. This is launched at off stump, and Nitish jams his bat down to drive it back to Shami, who stops it with his right boot
beaten. Nitish leaps and looks to ramp this short delivery around sixth stump, but misses. Shami bowled that at 139kph
full and flatter, and just outside off. Driven to deep cover point
"uuuuiii," says Pant!! On a length, and around fifth stump, as the ball turns away slightly to go past the outside edge as Nitish looked to have a jab at it
Digvesh keeps going short. This is wide of off again, and cut away after the turn, for a single to deep cover point
another short ball from Digvesh. He bowls this wide of off, and the ball turns away. Cut away to deep point
shortish in length, and cut away to point from wide of off

superb take by Pant!! He first leaped in excitement, then moved to his left with the angle, and finally dived across to his right to gobble it one-handed. This is what happened with the ball: Livingstone went for the lap sweep, but ended up top-edging it. The ball popped up behind him, and Pant was alert to the opportunity, although his jump gave the impression that he thought Livingstone was hit on the pad. In fact, replays show the ball went up off Livingstone's left shoulder
slower ball again, and another short ball as well. This pitches in the corridor just outside off, and is pulled to deep square leg by rolling his wrists
short of a length, and slightly wider outside off. Punched to point as he plays late again
lack of pace, and short and wide outside off. Klaasen rides the bounce to swat it to deep cover point
goes full, and around the sixth-stump channel. Livingstone taps to deep third by playing late, and with bat behind pad
bowls short, and just outside off. Pulled to deep square leg, as the man isn't all the way back at the boundary
starts with a short-of-a-length ball just outside off, and Klaasen punches to point
much fuller, and angled into off. Driven back to Siddharth
bang!! The first six of the day. Livingstone skips down the pitch, and clobbers this length ball on off over long-on. It's a liberal swing of the arms
full and quick, and on off or thereabouts. Blocked down to cover
darts this into a stump-to-stump line, and bowls on a length. Punched to long-off by Klaasen
again bowls full, but this is on middle. Punched to cover
full and quick, and angling into middle and leg. Clipped to square leg
he decides to counter Shami by walking down, but only ends up dabbing at this shortish ball around sixth stump to short third. Another great over from Shami
this time the slower ball is sliced, although not very convincingly. Shami bowls full and around sixth stump, as Livingstone mistimes an attempted loft over wide mid-off. Two more for him
short of a length on off, and Livingstone is hit on his back thigh as he looks to pull but misses. The ball would have gone over the stumps
a leading edge, and the ball goes over cover point. He went flicking at this length delivery seaming into his pads, but seemed to have played early

another slower ball, as the SRH batters can barely find a solution to it. Shami bowls this on the shorter side of a length, and around fifth stump. Livingstone is beaten on the inside edge as he looks to fend away from his body
on the bounce to the man at square leg. Shami bowls it on a length on middle, and Livingstone whips it away
shorter side of a length on off, and punched towards mid-off
full in length, but the line in the channel outside off remains the same. Klaasen lets it go
good start. Shorter side of a length, and just outside off. Klaasen looks to block but is beaten on the outside edge as the ball straightens after pitching

bowled him!! Prince celebrates like a royal. He has flattened Kishan's off stump. Prince angled it across, and went with an upright seam. The ball landed around off or thereabouts, and Kishan went driving. But the ball just about shaped back in enough to smack the off stump, as Kishan was beaten

good running, although he made it in time. Shorter side of a length on off, and punched to mid-on after the ball seamed into him. Digvesh at mid-on did well to rush forward and aim for the stumps at his end
short in length, and around sixth stump. Punched powerfully to point
dabbed late to deep third, as Livingstone shifts his weight back to this short-of-a-length ball around fifth stump
another dot ball - and almost a single. The man at short extra cover fumbles, but the ball dribbles to mid-off. Livingstone drove it forward off a fullish length around off, but not in the gap
now Shami bowls it fuller. The length is fullish on middle, and Livingstone dabs it down
shorter side of a length, and just outside off. But the ball shapes away, and Livingstone again leaves it
full ball swinging in, and landing outside leg. He looks to flick but misses. Wide called. The first bad ball from Shami today
averted by the man coming into SRH's side today. Short of a length, and around a sixth-stump line. Livingstone lets it go

great catching!! LSG's fielding and Shami's skills have combined for the second wicket of the day. Head is beaten by the lack of pace as well - like Abhishek was. Shami bowls it on a short of a length on off, as he angles it across, and bowls with a scrambled seam at just 121kph. Head looks to push forward, but ends up losing the bottom hand off his bat, and awkwardly pops it up for Markram at mid-off. Markram does really well to dive forward and grab it low
on a length, as it lands around leg and turns away. Punched to long-off from middle
fuller in length, and again bowls faster. Driven from just outside off to long-off
on the bounce to the man at cover point. Short in length, and wide of off, as Kishan slashes but doesn't find the gap
short of a length on leg, and finishing on the stumps. Kishan blocks it back to Digvesh
short again, and on leg. This one turns away, and is much quicker at 101kph. Head punches it down to mid-on's right, as Prince stops the ball with a slide
pulled to fine leg. Digvesh starts with a short ball just outside leg, and Head pulls after clearing his front leg

gone!! The slip was just removed, but the man at short third completes a nice take. Siddharth placed there went low and dived to his right to grab the ball just above the ground. It was an outside edge off Abhishek's bat, as he went driving at this full delivery outside off. It was a slower ball, though - a really early use of the variation - from Shami, and Abhishek goes for a duck. Just one run from the first over, apart from the wicket
another near yorker. He ties Abhishek down with the inswing, and goes on leg. Pushed down to mid-on
off the mark, but off the inside edge. Head looks to drive at this length ball angling across and pitching on off, but the ball dribbles to cover
amazing bowling. Shami not only finds sharp inswing but also lands it as a yorker. The ball arrives bang on the base of leg stump, and Head swings to square leg
shorter side of a length, and just outside leg. Head opens his stance up to nudge to square leg
some nice inswing first ball. Shami lands it on Head's pad, as the batter looks to clip but gets it off his pad. Pant dives to his right to save a few runs
Third time's the charm and Pant wins it for LSG! Gentle tap of the glove to the partner. Wide, full ball, Pant gets on one knee and with a mostly horizontal bat, slaps it over mid-off
Driven... straight to mid-off. Mukul takes off and is sent back early. Low full toss, Pant hitting it along the ground
Wide yorker is chomped to cover, fielder's well in

Shot of the match and that's the game sealed! Pant's upper-body leant to the leg side, contorted himself again and flat-batted a shortish ball, from shoulder-height mind you, and flat-batted it over mid-off tennis style

It is yorker first ball... but is drilled to the straight boundary! Long-on chased to the right, no long-off. Beats the dive. Very good ball, at the stumps but Pant somehow got underneath and drove it through

Given lbw, LSG review. Will be a dot either way. Was a highish full toss that hit the outer-half of the back thigh. Mukul swung across the line and missed... and got hit outside the line of the stumps, Hawk-Eye shows
Another dot, cue ended back to the bowler. Was a shin-high full toss on off. Mukul pre-meditated again, got across and went for the sweep.

Appeal for caught behind. Bowler not keen. No review taken. Was a shortish pace-on ball outside off. Mukul went across, got inside the line and looked to scoop it while standing mostly upright. Misses
Low full toss outside off, looks to go over cover, gets it to the sweeper along the ground
Short and wide, sits up proper. Cut hard to deep cover, where Nitish fumbles and allows the second
Low full toss outside off, flicked aerially to long-on
Livingstone charges but can't stop it. Very low full toss, drilled back past the bowler. All along the ground. Pant brings up fifty, no celebration
Pitched up, driven down the ground

Taken at long-off, SRH hanging on even if barely. Samad got the ball he wanted, full and just outside off. Went for the step-hit, rotational arc with the bat face looking at the sky. Scraped it flat to the fielder
Walks towards the bowler, gets a back of length ball darted at the stumps. Whipped to deep square leg
Lot of bottom hand in that slap to cover. Full follow through, onto the back shoulder. Ball was a touch short outside off
Crowd catch back to the bowler. Pant danced down and drove the full ball back
Slower length ball outside off is carved to deep-backward point. That's Malinga done for the day
Slower bouncer beats him. Angling away just outside off, Pant went for a swat-cut
Now the yorker flies, long-off does well to cut it off. Stopped in front of the sighscreen. Ball was at the stumps and Samad drove it flat over the bowler
Into the pitch not working now, short and wide ball sits up. Samad jumps and helicopters a cut. Watch out for the whiplash. Over backward point
Slower one outside off, cut to point
Close yorker, pumped down the ground. Almost takes out Rishabh and beats long-on to the right. The very full ball on off tailed in but Samad smothered it
Pitched up outside off, driven to deep cover
Short just under shoulder height, pulled to deep-backward square
Stolen two. Turns it off the back foot to the edge of the ring at square leg. Kishan chases, turns and throws in one motion. It's off target
Another leg-side boundary, to the right of deep fine leg this time. And it's off a low full toss. Pant flicking it from middle stump. Four fielders deep on the leg side, Pant still finding the gap
Dances down and gets bumped. Slower one outside off, pulled into the ground. Goes to long-on
That breaks some pressure. Unadkat misses his line by a touch, Pant gets on one kne and twirls across while helping the back-of-length ball fine
Overthrows? No, bowler backs up the throw from point. Was guided there by Pant off the back foot. Timeout
Length outside off, square driven to deep point
Pant looks for the boundary, doesn't time it. Back of length outside off, back leg moves across and he slaps it to deep cover
Runs stopped at point, crowd are happy. They have take one though. DIve to the right. Shortish ball outside off, jumps and cuts from the crease
Goes for the yorker, it's overpitched, punched to cover. Might've reversed
Length outside off, driven on the rise. Long-off runs left and dives to stop
Length just outside off, punched to long-off
Shortish ball spinning in towards off is pulled to deep midwicket
Fullish just outside off, driven to long-off
Nearly a caught and bowled. Pant dancing down, getting to the pitch and punching it. Ball may have stuck in the pitch and hovered
Pulled to the right of long-on, very short, well outside off

Pooran finds a new way to lose his wicket... It's a touch unfortunate. He swept it into the pitch, Kishan moved right and caught it on the bounce, Pooran didn't know that and took a couple of steps. When he turned, the bails were off. The ball spun away a touch which might be why the ball went that fine. Any which way, rare dismissal
Wide on a length, Pooran gets his back foot across and cuts to backward point
Yorker fired on leg at 105ks, beats the flick and goes off the pad behind square
Low full toss on leg is flicked through square leg
Goes for it second ball. It was the fullness in length that pushed him into it, driven off the bottom part of the bat to long-on
Wide on a length, let go

Dubey outfoxes Badoni. The batter danced down but got yorked, the 99ks ball was well outside off, so Badoni had to reach out to punch it away. Got beaten, Kishan whips off the bails without his hands going back, Dhoni style
Full and short. Pant's ready. Twirls, uses the spin in to pull it just behind square. That'll reassure the LSG fans
Overpitched and Pant breaks free. He gets forward, waits for it to get in line with his back leg and drives over mid-off
Length outside off, swept to deep midwicket
Quick single to short fine leg, throw low and wide of the keeper. Direct hit may have been tight. Length on leg, flicked softly.
Length on the pads, flicked to deep midwicket
Nicely played. Leans across and drives the full ball against the spin through cover.
slower ball from wide of the crease. Badoni pushes at it away from his body for a single to point's right
another short ball, but this is pulled from off by taking his eyes off. Single to fine leg
on the bounce to the point fielder. Shortish in length on middle, and Pant is nearly cramped in slashing at that
slower ball, and full on off. Chipped to wide long-on
great effort, but that's still four. The man at deep cover point ran and dived to his left to try and stop the ball. Badoni had punched that length delivery outside off, and beaten point to his right
bowls a short ball at a lack of pace. The ball arrives at Pant outside off despite pitching outside leg, and he pulls to short fine leg
floated full, and around sixth stump. Driven to long-on off the inside half of the bat
full and outside leg, and swept to fine leg. Shivang has done well in this over so far
Pant shapes to skip down, and Shivang fires a yorker-length ball on middle. Driven to long-on
ohh, nicely turned into him. Shivang bowls this on a length on off, and Badoni punches from middle towards cover point

taken on the long-off boundary. The ball went really high, but still gave the impression that it was on its way for six. The wrong 'un from Shivang, as he angles it across, and goes full on off. The ball turns away, and Markram mistimes his attempted loft through the line. Livingstone didn't have to move an inch either way at long-off to take that
on the bounce to the man at deep midwicket. Short ball from Shivang on off, as the ball straightens. Pant pulls with a swivel
Abhishek at extra cover dives to his left and gets his hand, but the ball dribbles away to mid-off. Pant had slashed at this fullish delivery outside off by reaching out
a knee-height full toss on off, and punched to deep extra cover. Pant and Markram do well to pinch two
a yorker-length ball on leg, and hits Pant on his pad. Malinga and Kishan appeal for lbw, but it's turned down. Pant was looking to clip it away
slower ball, and beaten. Short delivery on middle and leg, and it slants away to go past Pant's bat, as he went for the pull

nearly gone again!! Maybe Pant needs this luck to get going. Shivang, the man at fine leg, moved and dived to his right, but couldn't get a hand. Pant had whipped this length delivery angling into him, and this time it was hit powerfully
barely clears mid-off!! The fielder there was moving back with his eyes on the ball, but the ball dropped behind him. Pant sliced this full delivery around off, but mistimed it

dropped by Kishan?! We'll see. Nope, it's given as byes. Short of a length from Shivang, who bowled outside off, and got this to turn into Pant. The latter went for the cut but missed, but I seemed to have heard a sound as the ball went through Kishan's gloves as well. Pant and Markram pinched a bye, though, as the ball trickled away
full and slower on middle. Driven off the outside half of the bat to point for a hurried single
fired down the ground. Full ball on middle and off, and he clears his front leg to drill that back for four
on the shorter side again, and wide-ish of off. Slapped to deep cover point
good job by Aniket, as he runs and tumbles to his left from deep cover point. Pant cut at this short-of-a-length ball turning away from to finish around sixth stump, and got two
full and on middle and off. Driven down to long-off
short of a length, and finishing outside off after pitching on middle. Slapped to point
on the shorter side of a length on off, and pushed aerially to long-on
slower ball. But this arrives as a dipping full toss on middle and off. Pant whips it to wide long-on
short of a length, and shaping into middle and off. Punched to long-on
a freakish shot typical Pant style. Short delivery wide of leg from Harshal, and Pant goes for the pull. Pant gets the bottom edge all the way to deep third!!
bowls from wide of the crease, and goes full around off. Driven to mid-off
what a sound off the bat!! Markram pumps Unadkat over fine leg. Another short ball which angles into him, and he rides the bounce to clobber it over the man at the boundary
change of pace and length. Short and slow, as it pitches around seventh stump. Markram looks to pull as the ball gets big on him, but misses

wow, more luck goes Markram's way. He's not entirely in control of this drive, as the ball dips on to him to arrive as a low full toss. Unadkat thinks there's a caught-and-bowled chance, but the ball zooms past him even as Markram's bottom hand came off the bat
another lovely punch, but this goes straight to the man at extra cover, who's at the edge of the circle. Shortish in length again from Unadkat, but this one is around off

ufff, just falls between mid-off and extra cover!! Markram punched at it aerially, as the ball was short and shaped away to finish outside off. For a second, it seemed like he was gone, but the ball went in the gap for four
shorter side of a length, and angling into off. Flicked to square leg from middle stumps
lack of pace to Pant as well. This ball is on a length on off, and shapes away. Pant pushes to deep third
gets a ball on the shorter side of a length on off, and punches to cover point

gone!! Taken at deep square leg. This ball is banged in short, and on off. There's slight seam movement back in, and also considerable bounce. Marsh goes for the pull, but gets it off the higher side of the bat. The ball flies to Nitish at the boundary
another slower ball, but this time Marsh isn't fooled. Short of a length, and just outside off. Marsh lets the ball come into him, and punches just wide of mid-off
hard length now. This is fired on off, and Marsh pulls to midwicket off the higher side of the bat
starts with a slower ball, and beats Marsh. It is a fullish ball in offspinner style, as it dips and moves in as Marsh looks to loft and misses
lack of pace from Unadkat, who goes short and wide of off again. Marsh picks this up from outside off for a pull to deep midwicket
this time there's a fielder at deep midwicket. Another short delivery, but wide of off. Markram pulls it to the man out
angled in, and short of a length on middle and off. This almost cramps Markram for room, as he pushes it back
wow. Shot of the day, I think!! A pick-up pull, if there was ever one. Short in length, and arriving around off, as Markram pulls that late to go wide of mid-on for a delightful hit
short of a length on middle, and punched to mid-on
there's a man out at deep point, and he moves to his right to cut this off. Short in length from Unadkat, and on middle. Marsh slashes this from outside off, as the ball seams away
short in length, and on the stumps. Punched to wide long-off
full again, but this time it's much straighter. Driven back to Dubey
much fuller and quicker, and on off. Punched to long-off
thumped down the ground. Slower from Dubey, but Markram is aware. Full and dipping on off, and he clears his front leg to heave at that
on a length, and slanting in to arrive on leg or just outside leg. Nudged to mid-on by opening his stance up
shortish in length, and angling into off. Punched to long-off
one bounce, and four over mid-off. Marsh plays a lovely loft off this full ball swinging into off, and plays with a high left elbow. That looked so stylish
on the shorter side around off. Punched down to mid-off for a quick single
swatted between extra cover and cover point. Nitish goes back to the short-of-a-length area, and this time the line is wide of off as well. Markram thrashes at it for four more
whipped just over the man at midwicket!! A bottom-handed swing by Markram at this fullish delivery floated on middle and off. That came off the inside half of the bat, but was still well timed
